record.field: Answers to common questions about ERA's bilingual SEO services for the Saudi market.

div.h3: What does an ERA SEO engagement include?
div.p: A technical audit, on-page optimization in Arabic and English, JSON-LD structured data, and monthly reporting against your target keywords.
div.h3: How long until we see results?
div.p: Technical fixes are reflected within days; ranking improvements for competitive Arabic and English keywords typically build over three to six months.
